title: Go where the heart is washed clean
summary: By the saints' grace, cleansing becomes Naam on the tongue rather than another private attempt to feel clean.
takeaway: Let cleansing lead you into Naam, not self-inspection.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation where remembrance can begin again.

source.shortMeaning: The saints' grace does not only wash the heart; it turns the washed heart toward chanting Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison dirties the mind, enter the company that returns you to Naam instead of another private inspection.

evidence.coreClaim: The saints' grace does not only wash the heart; it turns the washed heart toward chanting Naam.
evidence.turn: Let cleansing become remembrance instead of a new fixation on the self.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before starting one more private search, step into sangat, kirtan, or one truthful conversation where remembrance can begin again.
